findings.evidence: The dbff837f digest reports 118 removed units but shows only 40.
findings.fix: Inspect the complete digest and account for each omitted removal in the recovery record; restore substantive unexplained content to the appropriate reference or main workflow.

findings.evidence: "Routine edits and audits load none"; the checklist is loaded only "when creating a README or restructuring one."
findings.fix: Route a review of a README with a Last reviewed line to the Config checklist, or move its date-update rule into the review workflow, so that rule is available when it applies.

findings.evidence: "establish the intended registry ... then check availability ... (`npm view <name> versions`, `pip index versions <name>`, `cargo search <name>`)"
findings.fix: Show how to pass the identified registry to each query, including Cargo's --registry and pip's --index-url when needed; otherwise mark availability unverified. A bare cargo search queries the default registry and can produce the wrong conclusion for an alternate registry.

findings.evidence: "Items the files cannot confirm ... registry availability ... are labeled unverified ... never asserted as working or broken," even though the registry gotcha directs a network availability check.
findings.fix: Distinguish claims checked successfully against an authoritative live source from claims that could not be checked, and report the source and verification method without labeling a successful live check unverified.

findings.evidence: The version-sensitive vendor CLI flag "pip `--index-url`" has no source URL and checked date in the skill and is not read from live help.
findings.fix: Instruct the agent to consult the installed pip index command's --help for registry options, or add the official pip documentation URL and date checked alongside the flag.
